Here are the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet on 20 June 2026 (UTC) — showing the first 20 slots:

| slot | slot_start (UTC) | first_seen (ms after slot start) | nodes |

| 14590812 | 2026-06-20 00:02:47 | 1722 | 157 |
| 14590813 | 2026-06-20 00:02:59 | 2111 | 157 |
| 14590814 | 2026-06-20 00:03:11 | 1382 | 157 |
| 14590815 | 2026-06-20 00:03:23 | 3046 | 157 |
| 14590816 | 2026-06-20 00:03:35 | 1392 | 157 |
| 14590817 | 2026-06-20 00:03:47 | 3440 | 157 |
| 14590818 | 2026-06-20 00:03:59 | 2959 | 157 |

The query used `mainnet.fct_block_first_seen_by_node` from the `xatu-cbt` dataset, taking the minimum `seen_slot_start_diff` per slot (the earliest time any of the 157 observing nodes first saw the block, in milliseconds after the slot started). The actual first-seen wall clock time = `slot_start_date_time + first_seen_ms / 1000`.

To see the full day (all ~7200 slots), remove the `LIMIT 20`.

- **View:** http://127.0.0.1:2480/api/v1/storage/files/7817a22a868a/13198bc6-e007-4565-84b3-2d31584110c6/arrival_histogram.png
- **Server path:** `/home/runner/.panda/data/storage/7817a22a868a/13198bc6-e007-4565-84b3-2d31584110c6/arrival_histogram.png`

The histogram plots the distribution of `first_seen_ms` across all ~7200 mainnet slots on 20 June 2026, showing that the vast majority of blocks are first seen within ~3 seconds of the slot start, with a long tail beyond that.
